astral-scribe: Use the reference only for detailed 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG pixel-art style, presentation, and 2x2 atlas layout, not its creature design. Create a clearly DIFFERENT fourth-battle enemy for a moonlit magic court: an elegant floating astral spellkeeper, a spectral masked sorcerer in deep teal and indigo robes, long pointed hood, silver moon filigree, pale turquoise magical flame, holding an open grimoire; an organic magical spirit, NOT a stone golem, armored knight, moth, or crowned boss. Full figure, clear readable silhouette, consistent exact same costume, face left toward the player. Make four well-separated full-body poses in a strict 2x2 sprite atlas: top-left idle hovering; top-right channeling with one hand raised; bottom-left casting, projecting magic from hand; bottom-right recoiling as hit. Each entire figure including all objects stays inside its own equal quadrant with generous transparent empty gutters, same scale and feet baseline in each quadrant. Detailed adult proportions and crisp pixel edges like reference. Transparent background, no shadows outside figures, no words, labels, borders, or extra figures.
